//: Composite indexes for the feed. Firestore will serve each of the feed's four queries from a single-field index only if the filter and the order are on the same field, which none of them are: the home feed filters on visibility, userId or visibleToUids and orders by createdAt. Without these the listeners fail with FAILED_PRECONDITION / 'The query requires an index'. Deploy with: firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes

indexes.//: Public posts, newest first. Also serves the legacy query: Firestore's `== null` matches a missing field, and a null filter with an order on a different field needs its own index.
Your own posts, newest first. Needed whichever way round the two fields are combined.
Restricted posts you are in the audience of, newest first.
